item: redacted_thinking placeholder (1.21): the API's encrypted thinking block renders as a labelled no-body thought line, live and on replay
branch: content_block_start{content_block.type:'redacted_thinking'} in 75-retraction.js → thinkBlock('',0,true) appended at once (no deltas ever follow); thinkBlock's `redacted` arm in 50-blocks.js; SessionStore emits {role:'thinking',redacted:true} and 55-replay.js passes it through
provenance: INFERRED, not measured. No local transcript or wire capture holds a redacted_thinking block (checked 2026-08-29, 21 transcripts on disk). The content-block shape {type:'redacted_thinking', data:<base64>} is the Anthropic Messages API's documented one, and the CLI binary (2.1.251) lists redacted_thinking among the block types it forwards (strings). The stream_event framing is fixture 40's / 45's. What is asserted is only what the renderer must do with that shape; that the CLI emits it on this wire is unproven. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-29, wrong-value form (the sandbox was launched after the edit, so no free pre-fix build existed): a temp copy with the .think.redacted count flipped to 0 and the summary text to 'Thought' FAILED all four flipped asserts (live count, live text, replay count, replay text) and passed the rest; deleted after the run. The redacted line did not exist in any earlier build (thinkBlock had no third parameter), so a pre-fix build reads 0 for every count here. TRIGGER ATTEMPTS 2026-08-29: the once-documented ANTHROPIC_MAGIC_STRING_TRIGGER_REDACTED_THINKING_… test string was sent in the user turn on three headless runs (Sonnet 5 ×2, Opus 5 ×1, CLI 2.1.251, panel flags) — every run returned a plain `thinking` block (empty body + signature) and no redacted_thinking; the current platform docs (platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking, 2026-08-29) no longer list the string, state the block appears only on genuine safety redaction, and state Fable 5 / Mythos 5 never return it. So this fixture stays the only evidence for 1.21, by necessity.
